parent_channels.name: P1: Guidance as Assembly and Cultivation
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Guidance becomes durable by joining, restraining, maintaining, and cultivating rather than by merely transmitting information.

subchannels.active_motifs: joining or stitching material `quranic:root_001283:B001/m01`; written text `quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`; restraint for correction `quranic:root_000348:B001/m01`; secure workmanship `quranic:root_000348:B004/m01`; gentle route guidance `quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`; leading vanguard `quranic:root_001583:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 31:2 كِتَٰبِ (ك ت ب) and حَكِيمِ (ح ك م); 31:3 and 31:5 هُدًى (ه د ي).
subchannels.name: Braced Text Leads the Route
subchannels.scene_or_process: A written object is joined and made firm, then functions as a gentle guide and a leading edge on a route.
subchannels.synthesis: The book is not only writing: its root imagery joins separate pieces, while wisdom restrains disorder and brings the construction to firmness. Guidance then extends that fitted object into motion, both indicating the road gently and taking the forward position that lets others follow.

subchannels.active_motifs: sustained care and maintenance `quranic:root_001273:B004/m01`; established worship `quranic:root_000879:B003/m01`; giving or delivery `quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`; vegetative increase `quranic:root_000637:B001/m01`; purification and soundness `quranic:root_000637:B002/m01`; cleaving ground open `quranic:root_001175:B001/m01`; enduring success `quranic:root_001175:B005/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 31:4 يُقِيمُ (ق و م), صَّلَوٰةَ (ص ل و), يُؤْتُ (ء ت ي), and زَّكَوٰةَ (ز ك و); 31:5 مُفْلِحُونَ (ف ل ح).
subchannels.name: Maintained Practice Breaks Ground
subchannels.scene_or_process: Repeated worship and giving are maintained like cultivation, where purification becomes growth and difficult ground opens into lasting yield.
subchannels.synthesis: Establishing prayer and giving alms form a maintained practice rather than isolated acts. Purification carries the parallel image of plant increase, while success reaches back to splitting resistant ground; the moral outcome is figured as a field opened, tended, and kept in productive condition.

parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 31:2-5, anchored in ٱلْكِتَٰبِ, ٱلْحَكِيمِ, هُدًى, يُقِيمُ, صَّلَوٰةَ, يُؤْتُ, زَّكَوٰةَ, and مُفْلِحُونَ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The written guide behaves both like stitched material under restraint and like cultivated ground whose yield appears through sustained care.

parent_channels.name: P1: Discourse as Route Steering
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Speech steers attention and movement by controlling what is purchased, processed, heard, and announced.

subchannels.active_motifs: commercial exchange `quranic:root_000792:B001/m01`; renewed speech or report `quranic:root_000299:B003/m01`; distraction from another object `quranic:root_001382:B001/m01`; deviation from a route `quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`; extended road `quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`; mockery `quranic:root_001587:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 31:6 يَشْتَرِى (ش ر ي), حَدِيثِ (ح د ث), لَهْوَ (ل ه و), يُضِلَّ (ض ل ل), سَبِيلِ (س ب ل), and هُزُوًا (ه ز ء).
subchannels.name: Purchased Talk Trades Away the Road
subchannels.scene_or_process: Speech is acquired in an exchange and used as a diversion that turns travelers off a traversable way.
subchannels.synthesis: The exchange does not merely obtain entertainment; it purchases a steering instrument. Talk occupies attention, deviation changes the travel line, and ridicule helps make the abandoned road seem unworthy of passage.

subchannels.active_motifs: spoken report `quranic:root_000299:B003/m01`; grain cast into a mill `quranic:root_001382:B003/m01`; flesh at the mouth and throat `quranic:root_001382:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 31:6 حَدِيثِ (ح د ث) and لَهْوَ (ل ه و).
subchannels.name: Diversion Passes Through Two Mouths
subchannels.scene_or_process: Diverting talk is materialized as grain placed into a mill-mouth and as articulation at the rear of the human mouth.
subchannels.synthesis: Two concrete senses of the diversion root create an input-output mechanism. Material is fed into the mouth of a mill, while speech is formed at the mouth and throat; diversionary talk is thus reframed as something processed and issued, not an immaterial absence of seriousness.

subchannels.active_motifs: following through recitation `quranic:root_000186:B001/m01`; hearing `quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`; hearing as understanding or obedience `quranic:root_000741:B003/m01`; physical ear `quranic:root_000022:B001/m01`; receptive listening `quranic:root_000022:B002/m01`; weight lodged in the ear `quranic:root_001674:B001/m01`; turning away `quranic:root_001684:B007/m01`; arrogance `quranic:root_001281:B006/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 31:7 تُتْلَىٰ (ت ل و), يَسْمَعْ (س م ع), أُذُنَيْ (ء ذ ن), وَقْرًا (و ق ر), وَلَّىٰ (و ل ي), and مُسْتَكْبِرًا (ك ب ر).
subchannels.name: Recitation Meets a Loaded Ear
subchannels.scene_or_process: Recitation reaches the hearing apparatus, but receptivity is replaced by weight, turning, and proud refusal.
subchannels.synthesis: Recitation offers a sequence to be followed, and hearing could complete itself as understanding and compliance. Instead, the ear becomes a loaded container; bodily turning and arrogance convert failed reception into an enacted refusal.

subchannels.active_motifs: glad announcement `quranic:root_000120:B005/m01`; punitive suffering `quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`; bodily pain `quranic:root_000046:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 31:7 بَشِّرْ (ب ش ر), عَذَابٍ (ع ذ ب), and أَلِيمٍ (ء ل م).
subchannels.name: Announcement Reverses into Pain
subchannels.scene_or_process: The form of a favorable announcement is retained while its content is reversed into punishment and bodily pain.
subchannels.synthesis: The command to announce keeps the social form of good news but fills it with its opposite. Punishment is thereby delivered through a discourse reversal, and the reversal terminates in felt pain rather than remaining verbal irony.

parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 31:6-7, anchored in يَشْتَرِى, حَدِيثِ, لَهْوَ, سَبِيلِ, يُضِلَّ, تُتْلَىٰ, يَسْمَعْ, أُذُنَيْ, وَلَّىٰ, and بَشِّرْ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Diverting speech becomes both traded cargo and material fed through mouths, while refusal becomes a weighted hearing mechanism and an inverted announcement.

parent_channels.name: P1: Security Made Durable
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Security is produced by enclosure, permanence, binding, and exact construction.

subchannels.active_motifs: security and trust `quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`; assent `quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`; covering or concealment `quranic:root_000266:B001/m01`; tree-covered garden `quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`; protective shield `quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`; good condition or bliss `quranic:root_001525:B001/m01`; permanence `quranic:root_000429:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 31:8 ءَامَنُ (ء م ن), جَنَّٰتُ (ج ن ن), and نَّعِيمِ (ن ع م); 31:9 خَٰلِدِينَ (خ ل د).
subchannels.name: Garden as Covered Refuge
subchannels.scene_or_process: Assent opens into security, and a covered garden becomes a shielding enclosure of good condition and permanence.
subchannels.synthesis: Belief and safety occupy the same lexical frame, while the garden is first an enclosure made by covering vegetation and then a shield. Bliss names the condition inside that enclosure, and permanence prevents the refuge from becoming temporary shelter.

subchannels.active_motifs: promise `quranic:root_001662:B001/m01`; binding obligation `quranic:root_000347:B002/m01`; tightly woven speech `quranic:root_000347:B010/m01`; secure workmanship `quranic:root_000348:B004/m01`; permanence `quranic:root_000429:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 31:9 وَعْدَ (و ع د), حَقًّا (ح ق ق), حَكِيمُ (ح ك م), and خَٰلِدِينَ (خ ل د).
subchannels.name: Promise Fitted and Braced
subchannels.scene_or_process: A promise is bound as an obligation, woven into exact speech, and secured as a finished construction.
subchannels.synthesis: The promise is not left as projected speech. Truth binds it as an obligation and compares verified language to a tightly woven fabric; wisdom supplies structural firmness, and permanence is the resulting state.

parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 31:8-9, anchored in ءَامَنُ, جَنَّٰتُ, نَّعِيمِ, خَٰلِدِينَ, وَعْدَ, حَقًّا, and حَكِيمُ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Garden, promise, and truth converge as different forms of protected space and fitted construction.

parent_channels.name: P1: Measured Making and Its Counterfeit
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Making proceeds through measure, support, delivery, growth, and distribution, while false making substitutes fabrication for that ordered process.

subchannels.active_motifs: prior measurement `quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`; created formation `quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`; overhead canopy `quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`; supporting pillar `quranic:root_001043:B003/m01`; anchoring weight `quranic:root_000564:B001/m01`; casting `quranic:root_001372:B005/m01`; unstable swaying `quranic:root_001459:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 31:10 خَلَقَ (خ ل ق), سَّمَٰوَٰتِ (س م و), عَمَدٍ (ع م د), رَوَٰسِىَ (ر س و), أَلْقَىٰ (ل ق ي), and تَمِيدَ (م ي د).
subchannels.name: Sky and Earth Form a Load Path
subchannels.scene_or_process: A measured upper canopy is supported over ground stabilized by cast anchors against lateral sway.
subchannels.synthesis: Creation begins as proportioning and becomes a structural system. The sky is an overhead cover, pillars supply the absent support under discussion, and mountains act as cast anchors that keep the occupied ground from swaying.

subchannels.active_motifs: downward movement `quranic:root_001492:B001/m01`; delivery of a supply `quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`; water as material `quranic:root_001458:B001/m01`; abundant water `quranic:root_001458:B002/m01`; irrigation `quranic:root_001458:B003/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 31:10 أَنزَلْ (ن ز ل) and مَآءً (م و ه).
subchannels.name: Water Is Delivered into Irrigation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water moves downward as a delivered supply, then becomes abundance and irrigation at the receiving ground.
subchannels.synthesis: Descent is specified as delivery rather than bare vertical motion. The delivered material can be a plentiful source and an irrigation operation, turning the sky-ground relation into a supply system.

subchannels.active_motifs: plant emergence `quranic:root_001465:B001/m01`; cultivation `quranic:root_001465:B002/m01`; paired counterpart `quranic:root_000652:B001/m01`; differentiated kind `quranic:root_000652:B004/m01`; fertile vegetation `quranic:root_001294:B002/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 31:10 أَنۢبَتْ (ن ب ت), زَوْجٍ (ز و ج), and كَرِيمٍ (ك ر م).
subchannels.name: Paired Growth Emerges from the Supply
subchannels.scene_or_process: Irrigated matter emerges as cultivated vegetation organized into pairs and distinguishable kinds.
subchannels.synthesis: Growth is not an undifferentiated mass. Emergence becomes cultivation, pairing supplies internal organization, and fertility names the quality of the resulting vegetation.

subchannels.active_motifs: scattering abroad `quranic:root_000083:B001/m01`; crawling movement `quranic:root_000457:B001/m01`; concealed flow under a surface `quranic:root_000457:B003/m01`; anchoring weight `quranic:root_000564:B001/m01`; resisted sway `quranic:root_001459:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 31:10 بَثَّ (ب ث ث), دَآبَّةٍ (د ب ب), رَوَٰسِىَ (ر س و), and تَمِيدَ (م ي د).
subchannels.name: Anchored Ground Carries Distributed Life
subchannels.scene_or_process: Stable ground receives a broad scattering of creatures whose movement stays close to or hidden within the surface.
subchannels.synthesis: The same ground that is prevented from swaying becomes the carrier for dispersed life. Crawling and concealed flow keep movement near the stabilized surface, so anchoring enables distribution rather than eliminating motion.

subchannels.active_motifs: created formation `quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`; fabrication of false speech `quranic:root_000434:B007/m01`; making visible for inspection `quranic:root_000531:B012/m01`; displacement from the proper place `quranic:root_000967:B004/m01`; deviation from a route `quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 31:11 خَلْقُ and خَلَقَ (خ ل ق), أَرُ (ر ء ي), ظَّٰلِمُونَ (ظ ل م), and ضَلَٰلٍ (ض ل ل).
subchannels.name: Creation Confronts Fabricated Making
subchannels.scene_or_process: An ordered act of creation is set against a rival act that fabricates, displays, misplaces, and diverts.
subchannels.synthesis: The challenge to show another creation tests rival making by visibility. One sense of creation itself supplies false fabrication, while wrongdoing shifts things from their proper position and error shifts travel from its proper course; counterfeit making is exposed as disordered placement and direction.

parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 31:10-11, anchored in خَلَقَ, سَّمَٰوَٰتِ, عَمَدٍ, رَوَٰسِىَ, تَمِيدَ, أَنزَلْ, مَآءً, أَنۢبَتْ, زَوْجٍ, بَثَّ, دَآبَّةٍ, أَرُ, ظَّٰلِمُونَ, and ضَلَٰلٍ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Cosmology is rendered as load-bearing engineering, irrigated cultivation, and controlled dispersal; the rival act of making appears as fabricated speech.

parent_channels.name: P2: Gratitude Makes Provision Visible
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A received good becomes legible through the response it produces, whereas denial covers the gift without diminishing its source.

subchannels.active_motifs: gratitude `quranic:root_000810:B001/m01`; thriving on little feed or rain `quranic:root_000810:B002/m01`; a full udder and abundant milk `quranic:root_000810:B003/m01`; fresh shoots `quranic:root_000810:B004/m01`; praise `quranic:root_000355:B001/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 31:12 ٱشْكُرْ, يَشْكُرْ, and يَشْكُرُ (ش ك ر), and حَمِيدٌ (ح م د).
subchannels.name: Small Input Produces Visible Yield
subchannels.scene_or_process: A slight feed or rain input becomes bodily fullness, fresh shoots, and an observable return.
subchannels.synthesis: Gratitude is a productive response whose effect shows outside itself. An animal thrives on little, an udder fills after pasture, and a plant greens or sends out shoots after slight rain; praise names the visible return to the giver.

subchannels.active_motifs: covering a blessing `quranic:root_001307:B004/m01`; burying seed `quranic:root_001307:B008/m01`; self-sufficiency `quranic:root_001110:B001/m01`; sufficing without another `quranic:root_001110:B002/m01`; the individual self `quranic:root_001533:B012/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 31:12 كَفَرَ (ك ف ر), غَنِىٌّ (غ ن ي), and نَفْسِ (ن ف س).
subchannels.name: Covering the Gift Does Not Drain the Source
subchannels.scene_or_process: Denial covers or buries what was given, but the source remains sufficient in itself.
subchannels.synthesis: Denial acts on reception and display: it covers the benefit and can resemble seed hidden in earth. The act returns upon the self, while the giver's sufficiency means that concealed acknowledgment cannot reduce the source.

parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 31:12, anchored in ٱشْكُرْ, يَشْكُرْ, حَمِيدٌ, كَفَرَ, غَنِىٌّ, and نَفْسِ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Gratitude is pictured through animals and plants that display a large yield from small provision, while denial resembles burying seed.

parent_channels.name: P2: Family Formation and Bounded Allegiance
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Family bonds form, carry, and accompany a person, but they do not erase the boundary between care and captured obedience.

subchannels.active_motifs: bridle-like restraint `quranic:root_000348:B006/m01`; building or forming `quranic:root_000156:B001/m01`; child or descendant `quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`; heart-softening admonition `quranic:root_001663:B001/m01`; spoken counsel `quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`; attributed partnership `quranic:root_000791:B002/m01`; displacement from the proper place `quranic:root_000967:B004/m01`.
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 31:12 حِكْمَةَ (ح ك م); 31:13 ٱبْنِ and بُنَىَّ (ب ن ي), يَعِظُ (و ع ظ), قَالَ (ق و ل), تُشْرِكْ and شِّرْكَ (ش ر ك), and ظُلْمٌ (ظ ل م).
subchannels.name: Counsel Builds and Reins the Child
subchannels.scene_or_process: A parent forms a child through softening counsel and corrective restraint while warning against a misplaced partnership.
subchannels.synthesis: The child is both a descendant and something under formation. Counsel softens rather than merely orders, while wisdom supplies the corrective rein; partnership with the divine is cast as a structural misplacement that this formative speech seeks to prevent.

subchannels.scene_or_process: Good companionship continues locally while allegiance follows the traces of a returning traveler on another road.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Moral practice holds a line by maintaining action, restraining intrusion, absorbing impact, and fixing resolve.

subchannels.name: Upright Practice Directs and Restrains
subchannels.scene_or_process: Maintained worship supports outward direction toward recognized good and restraint of what crosses a moral boundary.
subchannels.synthesis: Upright practice is maintained first, then extended as directed intervention. The known good supplies the orientation, the reprehensible marks a crossing, and restraint works both socially and as the internal rational capacity that holds the boundary.

subchannels.name: Impact Is Held by Fixed Resolve
subchannels.scene_or_process: An event strikes the agent, who contains the reaction and knots the heart into a route that pressure cannot turn.
subchannels.synthesis: Patience does not remove impact; it contains the self after impact. Resolve then supplies a knot and a directional pressure, turning endurance into continued motion along a fixed line.

parent_channels.surprising_reach: Command and patience share a mechanics of boundary maintenance: one restrains what crosses the line, and the other prevents impact from turning the agent off course.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Social projection is corrected by returning face, gait, and voice to measured scale.

subchannels.name: Gait Returns to the Middle
subchannels.scene_or_process: Exultant instability and self-display are reduced into a straight, moderate walking line.

subchannels.synthesis: The correction is acoustic and scalar. Sound is not eliminated; its amplitude and social harshness are reduced by contrast with the donkey's call, making proportion audible.

parent_channels.name: S9. P1-P2-P3: A Forward Sale Reaches Judgment
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 supplies interpersonal dealing and adjudication, P2 extends a crop sale across years and separates a verdict, and P3 closes the matter through accounting and action-matched recompense. Across P1, P2, and P3, the causal bridge reframes deeds as dealings whose terms can outlast immediate appearances: delay does not cancel the account, and final return realizes what the transaction incurred.

parent_channels.name: S10. P1-P2-P3: The Second Horse Holds a Measured Line
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Across P1, P2, and P3, a horse regulates its hoof-fall, the second runner keeps position behind the leader, and successive gallops sustain the ordered line. The bridge is a repeated race signature with role progression from gait to rank to continued running.
parent_channels.synthesis: The P1-P3 truth root supplies a horse whose rear hoof registers the place of its front hoof, while the P1-P2 prayer root names the runner whose head remains at the leader's rear. P2 adds the horses and the image of uninterrupted mane-like succession; P3 turns rain into run following run. The repeated race signature materializes the surah's path logic while pressing its warnings about inherited following: disciplined succession can establish pace and position, but following a predecessor does not by itself establish the course as true.

parent_channels.synthesis: Neglect initiates a causal chain from ungoverned movement to loss of recognized ownership and exposure to predation. Public description attempts to reverse that chain by making the animal identifiable again. The scene materializes the surah's guidance language: straying is not mere location but the loss of a protecting relation, while recognition and directed seeking restore a creature to accountable care.

parent_channels.scene_or_process: A capacious new waterskin is soaked until its stitch holes seal, filled to capacity, and then held by someone who refuses its benefit to others.
parent_channels.synthesis: Water first strengthens the vessel that receives it: soaking swells the stitched boundary shut, and continued filling realizes its capacity. Miserly holding then reverses that completed function by turning a sound container into blocked provision. The contrast supports the surah's account of blessing and gratitude: reception becomes fruitful only when what has been received remains available for benefit.

parent_channels.active_motifs: wrestler's restraining hold `quranic:root_000018:B011/m01`; standing against another in wrestling or combat `quranic:root_001273:B014/m01`; reciprocal counsel among a group `quranic:root_001656:B003/m01`; establishing peace between people `quranic:root_000564:B004/m01`; reconciliation that removes hostility `quranic:root_000876:B002/m01`.
parent_channels.name: S13. P1-P2: A Wrestling Hold Is Reversed into Reconciliation
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Two opponents lock into a wrestling hold, then exchange counsel until a mediator establishes reconciliation and removes estrangement.
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene reverses the relation between the same two sides: bodily capture and resistance give way to reciprocal speech, then to a peace made stable. It reframes Luqman's counsel and the surah's bounded family disagreement as nonviolent work on a relationship; durable correction ends opposition rather than merely winning the clinch.

parent_channels.active_motifs: cold fever touch and shiver `quranic:root_001004:B005/m01`; bodily tremor or convulsion `quranic:root_000025:B008/m01`; shaking caused by fear or anger `quranic:root_001251:B005/m01`; lung as the organ of breath `quranic:root_000531:B009/m01`; breath leaving the interior `quranic:root_001533:B001/m01`.
parent_channels.name: S14. Whole Surah: Fear Chills the Body into Tremor
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A fever-like chill reaches the body, produces involuntary shaking, and disturbs breath moving through the lungs.
parent_channels.synthesis: Fear becomes a physiological event rather than an abstract attitude: cold contact propagates as tremor and alters the body's interior rhythm. This materializes the demand for patience after impact and the fear attached to the final day. Containing the self does not mean feeling nothing; it means holding direction while the body itself shakes.

parent_channels.active_motifs: entering a name in a ruler's register for pay or provision `quranic:root_001283:B004/m01`; worker's wage or livelihood `quranic:root_001046:B004/m01`; continuing stipend, provision, or charity `quranic:root_000240:B006/m01`; forced unpaid labor `quranic:root_000685:B002/m01`.
parent_channels.name: S15. P1-P2-P3: A Payroll Register Divides Wages from Corvee
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A worker is enrolled for provision, receives wages or a continuing stipend, and is contrasted with labor compelled without pay.
parent_channels.synthesis: Registration makes service legible, wages answer completed labor, and a continuing allowance keeps the worker's provision from lapsing. Corvee is the contrast in which power takes service while withholding return. That reversal usefully pressures the surah's language of harnessed creation: divine subjection is presented as bestowed benefit, while the final account ensures that purposeful work is neither unrecorded nor unpaid.

parent_channels.active_motifs: the sanctuary or Kaaba as the sacred building `quranic:root_000156:B003/m01`; goods, food, or vessel used as journey provision `quranic:root_001395:B003/m01`; livestock wealth `quranic:root_001525:B005/m01`; livestock, wealth, or goods offered to the sanctuary `quranic:root_001583:B005/m01`.
parent_channels.name: S16. P1-P2-P3: A Provisioned Herd Is Led to the Sanctuary
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Useful goods and livestock are gathered as travel provision, directed to the sanctuary, and transferred from possession into a devotional offering.
parent_channels.synthesis: The rite gives direction to material benefit. Provision sustains the approach, livestock embodies stored wealth, and offering ends the journey by releasing that wealth at a sacred destination. The guidance root therefore becomes something led as well as something that leads, reframing the surah's gifts as resources whose proper direction can culminate in worship rather than possession.

parent_channels.active_motifs: voluntary donation beyond obligation `quranic:root_000956:B005/m01`; small present or choice gift `quranic:root_001356:B003/m01`; gift sent to a loved person `quranic:root_001583:B004/m01`; gift offered in pursuit of reward or praise `quranic:root_001294:B008/m01`.
parent_channels.name: S17. P1-P2: A Gift Discloses Its Expected Return
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A person voluntarily gives a small present to one held in affection, while a contrasting gift is offered as leverage for praise or recompense.
parent_channels.synthesis: The outward transfer can carry two opposed relations: affection gives without imposed debt, while strategic giving attempts to manufacture a return. This contrast sharpens the surah's treatment of almsgiving and gratitude. A beneficial act is not defined by visible transfer alone; its direction includes the response the giver is trying to purchase.

parent_channels.active_motifs: wayfarer or habitual road traveler `quranic:root_000672:B002/m01`; tent-dwelling people `quranic:root_001043:B004/m01`; tray or table bearing food `quranic:root_001459:B004/m01`; food, supplies, or hospitality prepared for a guest `quranic:root_001492:B005/m01`.
parent_channels.name: S18. P1-P2-P3: Tent Hosts Set a Table for a Wayfarer
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A road traveler reaches a tent-dwelling community and is received at a food tray with provision prepared for a guest.
parent_channels.synthesis: Travel and dwelling meet in one social transition: a person defined by the road becomes a guest when settled people prepare food for arrival. The scene materializes guidance and favor as hospitable infrastructure. A traversable way is completed not only by direction but by provision that lets the traveler continue.

parent_channels.active_motifs: one occurrence or state of death `quranic:root_001454:B008/m01`; shrouding and interring the dead `quranic:root_000266:B009/m01`; burial as disappearance into the earth `quranic:root_000913:B002/m01`; grave or remote inhabited ground `quranic:root_001307:B012/m01`.
parent_channels.name: S19. Whole Surah: Death Is Wrapped and Hidden in Ground
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A single death is followed by shrouding and interment until the body disappears within a grave or remote ground.
parent_channels.synthesis: Burial completes a sequence of concealment: death stills the body, wrapping removes it from view, and ground absorbs its visible trace. This scene materializes the unknown death-ground of 31:34 while setting pressure against 31:28: interment can hide a body from human sight, but it cannot make renewed creation more difficult.

parent_channels.active_motifs: seizure and capture of a prisoner `quranic:root_000018:B003/m01`; taking a person as captive `quranic:root_000737:B013/m01`; captive or refuge-seeker awaiting pledged protection `quranic:root_001583:B007/m01`; chief relied upon by the group `quranic:root_001043:B006/m01`.
parent_channels.name: S20. P1-P2-P3: Capture Is Not Chosen Surrender
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A person is seized and made captive, then stands as a prisoner or refuge-seeker under the pledge and protection of a relied-upon chief.
parent_channels.synthesis: Capture and protected surrender share an external transfer of control but reverse the agent's role. One begins in a captor's grip; the other seeks a pledge and a dependable protector. The contrast presses the primary reading of 31:22: entrusting one's face to God is not coerced seizure but chosen placement under an authority whose firm hold secures the person.

parent_channels.active_motifs: written manumission agreement `quranic:root_001283:B005/m01`; scheduled monetary installments under the agreement `quranic:root_001283:B005/m02`; emancipation as the agreement's completed outcome `quranic:root_001283:B005/m03`.
parent_channels.name: S21. P1-P2: A Written Freedom Contract Is Paid in Installments
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An enslaved person and owner write a manumission agreement, schedule monetary installments, and make fulfilled payment the route to release.
parent_channels.synthesis: Writing here neither merely describes nor permanently binds; it orders time, obligation, and release. Each payment moves the contract toward a freedom specified in advance. The scene reframes the surah's book, promise, and account imagery by showing a written obligation whose faithful fulfillment converts liability into liberation.

parent_channels.active_motifs: aiming a missile toward a chosen object `quranic:root_000053:B012/m01`; deliberately targeting a visible person or sign `quranic:root_000074:B002/m01`; arrow reaching the intended target `quranic:root_000889:B003/m01`; lethal strike at the place of impact `quranic:root_001230:B005/m01`; arrow veering away without scratching `quranic:root_001464:B005/m01`.
parent_channels.name: S22. Whole Surah: An Aimed Arrow Divides into Hit and Miss
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An archer deliberately selects a target and releases an arrow whose course ends either in a lethal hit or in a deviation that does not scratch.
parent_channels.synthesis: Intention fixes the target but does not collapse the difference between aim and outcome. The same release can arrive lethally or fall aside without injury. This scene materializes the surah's separation of responsible action from foreknowledge: deeds retain their chosen direction and are reportable, yet the agent does not thereby possess advance mastery over where death will occur.

parent_channels.active_motifs: belly girth securing a saddle or pack frame `quranic:root_000128:B006/m01`; bare wooden saddle frame `quranic:root_001029:B009/m01`; felt or cloth underlay beneath the saddle `quranic:root_001684:B011/m01`.
parent_channels.name: S23. P1-P2: Frame, Pad, and Girth Secure a Mount
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A wooden saddle frame is cushioned by an underpad and secured to the mount by a girth passing beneath the belly.
parent_channels.synthesis: Security arises from layered functions: the frame carries, the pad protects the contact surface, and the girth prevents lateral loss. The assembly materializes the surah's secure-trajectory imagery. A firm course depends not on a single grip but on correctly related inner support, outer structure, and binding restraint.

parent_channels.active_motifs: complete and polished ode `quranic:root_001230:B008/m01`; technical direction of a rhyme `quranic:root_001630:B011/m01`; sending praise or satire in verse `quranic:root_001583:B011/m01`; divisions and line endings that regulate speech or meter `quranic:root_001159:B011/m01`.
parent_channels.name: S24. P1-P2-P3: A Finished Poem Is Shaped and Sent
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A poet completes and refines an ode, regulates its divisions and rhyme, then sends it as praise or satire to an addressee.
parent_channels.synthesis: The poem is a manufactured discourse object: completion, measured division, and rhyme give it formal integrity before it is directed socially as commendation or attack. This usefully pressures the surah's contested speech field. Technical finish and memorable form can intensify a message's reach, but neither feature determines whether its direction is guidance or diversion.

parent_channels.active_motifs: encounter between opposed sides `quranic:root_001372:B004/m01`; face-to-face confrontation `quranic:root_001630:B003/m01`; forceful verbal rebuke `quranic:root_001559:B004/m01`; restraining or weaning someone from an act `quranic:root_000994:B003/m01`.
parent_channels.name: S25. P1-P2-P3: Face-to-Face Restraint Can Harden into Rebuke
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Two people meet in direct confrontation, where an attempt to restrain conduct is delivered as harsh verbal rebuke.
parent_channels.synthesis: Restraint and rebuke can occupy the same encounter while differing in social effect. The scene presses the surah's pairing of counsel, command, and vocal moderation: opposing a harmful act may be necessary, but harshness is not identical with moral clarity. Luqman's heart-softening address supplies the counter-form in which correction preserves the addressee as a participant rather than only a target.

quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
الٓمٓ
تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
هُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةًۭ لِّلْمُحْسِنِينَ
ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًۭى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَشْتَرِى لَهْوَ ٱلْحَدِيثِ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ وَيَتَّخِذَهَا هُزُوًا ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ
وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا وَلَّىٰ مُسْتَكْبِرًۭا كَأَن لَّمْ يَسْمَعْهَا كَأَنَّ فِىٓ أُذُنَيْهِ وَقْرًۭا ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقًّۭا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍۢ تَرَوْنَهَا ۖ وَأَلْقَىٰ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَبَثَّ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ دَآبَّةٍۢ ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۢ كَرِيمٍ
هَٰذَا خَلْقُ ٱللَّهِ فَأَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦ ۚ بَلِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
وَإِذْ قَالَ لُقْمَٰنُ لِٱبْنِهِۦ وَهُوَ يَعِظُهُۥ يَٰبُنَىَّ لَا تُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشِّرْكَ لَظُلْمٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُۥ وَهْنًا عَلَىٰ وَهْنٍۢ وَفِصَٰلُهُۥ فِى عَامَيْنِ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَيْكَ إِلَىَّ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

وَإِن جَٰهَدَاكَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن تُشْرِكَ بِى مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌۭ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا ۖ وَصَاحِبْهُمَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا مَعْرُوفًۭا ۖ وَٱتَّبِعْ سَبِيلَ مَنْ أَنَابَ إِلَىَّ ۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
يَٰبُنَىَّ إِنَّهَآ إِن تَكُ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍۢ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍۢ فَتَكُن فِى صَخْرَةٍ أَوْ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ أَوْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَأْتِ بِهَا ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌۭ
يَٰبُنَىَّ أَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأْمُرْ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَٱنْهَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَصَابَكَ ۖ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عَزْمِ ٱلْأُمُورِ
وَلَا تُصَعِّرْ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمْشِ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَرَحًا ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍۢ فَخُورٍۢ
وَٱقْصِدْ فِى مَشْيِكَ وَٱغْضُضْ مِن صَوْتِكَ ۚ إِنَّ أَنكَرَ ٱلْأَصْوَٰتِ لَصَوْتُ ٱلْحَمِيرِ

أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَأَسْبَغَ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعَمَهُۥ ظَٰهِرَةًۭ وَبَاطِنَةًۭ ۗ وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَٰدِلُ فِى ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ وَلَا هُدًۭى وَلَا كِتَٰبٍۢ مُّنِيرٍۢ
وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ قَالُوا۟ بَلْ نَتَّبِعُ مَا وَجَدْنَا عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَنَآ ۚ أَوَلَوْ كَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ يَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
۞ وَمَن يُسْلِمْ وَجْهَهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌۭ فَقَدِ ٱسْتَمْسَكَ بِٱلْعُرْوَةِ ٱلْوُثْقَىٰ ۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْأُمُورِ
وَمَن كَفَرَ فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ كُفْرُهُۥٓ ۚ إِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ فَنُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
نُمَتِّعُهُمْ قَلِيلًۭا ثُمَّ نَضْطَرُّهُمْ إِلَىٰ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍۢ
وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۚ قُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
وَلَوْ أَنَّمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِن شَجَرَةٍ أَقْلَٰمٌۭ وَٱلْبَحْرُ يَمُدُّهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ سَبْعَةُ أَبْحُرٍۢ مَّا نَفِدَتْ كَلِمَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌۭ
مَّا خَلْقُكُمْ وَلَا بَعْثُكُمْ إِلَّا كَنَفْسٍۢ وَٰحِدَةٍ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ

أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ كُلٌّۭ يَجْرِىٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ
ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلْبَٰطِلُ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱلْفُلْكَ تَجْرِى فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ بِنِعْمَتِ ٱللَّهِ لِيُرِيَكُم مِّنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍۢ شَكُورٍۢ

وَإِذَا غَشِيَهُم مَّوْجٌۭ كَٱلظُّلَلِ دَعَوُا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ فَمِنْهُم مُّقْتَصِدٌۭ ۚ وَمَا يَجْحَدُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَّا كُلُّ خَتَّارٍۢ كَفُورٍۢ

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ وَٱخْشَوْا۟ يَوْمًۭا لَّا يَجْزِى وَالِدٌ عَن وَلَدِهِۦ وَلَا مَوْلُودٌ هُوَ جَازٍ عَن وَالِدِهِۦ شَيْـًٔا ۚ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ ۖ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ

إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَيُنَزِّلُ ٱلْغَيْثَ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْحَامِ ۖ وَمَا تَدْرِى نَفْسٌۭ مَّاذَا تَكْسِبُ غَدًۭا ۖ وَمَا تَدْرِى نَفْسٌۢ بِأَىِّ أَرْضٍۢ تَمُوتُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌۢ
